hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); PATH_CHECK=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.content // ""'); if echo "$PATH_CHECK" | grep -q '/Documents/Obsidian/Loaiza/'; then echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"BLOCKED: Direct Obsidian vault access is not allowed. Use CouchDB instead: ssh hailmary \"cd /home/ecloaiza/devops/projects/mcc && python3 tools/vault_fetch.py --get|--put|--list <path>\""}'; exit 2; fi

INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'docker compose (down|rm)'; then ACTION=$(echo "$CMD" | grep -oE 'docker compose (down|rm)[^ ]*'); logger -n 192.168.5.25 -P 514 --udp -t claude-hook -p local0.info "DOCKER_COMPOSE: $ACTION from claude session"; fi

INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '^\s*git\s+push'; then SECRETS=$(git diff --cached 2>/dev/null | grep -iE '(AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|api[_-]?key\s*[:=]|token\s*[:=]|password\s*[:=]|secret\s*[:=]|\.secrets/)' || true); if [ -n "$SECRETS" ]; then echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"BLOCKED: Potential secrets detected in staged files. Review with git diff --cached before pushing."}'; exit 2; fi; fi

cd /home/ecloaiza/devops/github/linux_dotfiles && if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then source ~/.bashrc && FILES=$(git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null; git diff --name-only --cached 2>/dev/null; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard 2>/dev/null) && MSG="claude: update $(echo "$FILES" | sort -u | head -5 | tr '\n' ', ' | sed 's/,$//' | sed 's/,/, /g')" && gacp_dotfiles "$MSG"; fi

cd /home/ecloaiza/devops/github/adastra && if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then source ~/.bashrc && FILES=$(git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null; git diff --name-only --cached 2>/dev/null; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard 2>/dev/null) && MSG="claude: update $(echo "$FILES" | sort -u | head -5 | tr '\n' ', ' | sed 's/,$//' | sed 's/,/, /g')" && gacp_adastra "$MSG"; fi
